Messages.Author: ALEX HARMON
Messages.Body:
Another question here...can you play Taste of Vitae after striking with
Theft of Vitae? What about after the strike resolution of a round in
which Blood to Water was played?

Thanks in advance...

Alex

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
ALEX HARMON wrote:
>
> Another question here...can you play Taste of Vitae after striking with
> Theft of Vitae? What about after the strike resolution of a round in
> which Blood to Water was played?

Taste of Viate only counts blood lost to damage, so would not
count the blood stolen by Theft of Vitae nor lost to a "burn
blood" effect like Blood to Water.

You can play Taste, you just won't gain anything for it.
